# Word lists

<!-- Generated by tools/build_lexicon.py from lexicon/entries/*.yaml; do not edit by hand. -->

These lists are generated automatically from the project's [lexicon](https://github.com/kebasaa/kisiei-language/tree/main/lexicon) (3358 entries). Words are grouped by **semantic domain** following the [SIL Semantic Domains](https://semdom.org/v4/) classification; a word may appear in several domains. Attested words link to their first occurrence in the Kisiei Bible; <span class="ks-badge ks-conf">Confirmed</span> words are not in the Bible but confirmed by a speaker; <span class="ks-badge ks-res">Respelled</span> words come from the 1979 description and still need confirmation; <span class="ks-badge ks-south">Southern Kissi</span> words are known only from the Southern Kissi dictionary (Childs 2000): they are not attested in the North and are spelled as Childs writes them. The lexicon is also available as CSV and LIFT (for FieldWorks).
